domain: marine environment / harmful algal bloom (red tide) reporting
prediction_question: Will at least one red tide sighting be reported in Hong Kong waters within the next 7 days after a stated weekly publication instant, for a monitored fish culture zone or marine station? Formulated as an occurrence onset at location-week grain (not cell-count forecasting).
prediction_time: Weekly. Candidate instant: the publication of the red tide update containing all reports dated <= D, conservatively placed at D+8 23:59 HKT, with features restricted to data published by that instant and the target window starting strictly after it. NOT SUPPORTED AS WRITTEN: the publication lag is not bounded by observed evidence - the 2025-04-02 Wayback vintage carried its latest record at 2025-03-25 (8 days), while the 2019-11-02 vintage carried its latest record at 2019-05-31 (155 days).
target_definition: Binary: at least one red tide sighting report whose 'Date of Report' falls in (instant, instant+7] at a location within the monitored network. Label source columns 'Date of Report' and 'Location' in the AFCD red tide CSV, excluded from features by the window construction. Censoring is material: 'no report' conflates absence of a bloom with absence of observation. AFCD documents a monitoring programme (weekly sampling at 6 core fish culture zones, fortnightly at 5 more plus 5 offshore stations, quarterly at the remaining 15 fish culture zones) but publishes no per-day monitoring log, so the eligible negative population cannot be enumerated from the source.

license_evidence: DATA.GOV.HK Terms and Conditions of Use read 2026-10-23 (https://data.gov.hk/en/terms-and-conditions): 'You are allowed to browse, download, distribute, reproduce, hyperlink to, and print the Data for both commercial and non-commercial purposes on a free-of-charge basis on condition that:- ... you shall also give proper attribution to the Government, the Relevant Organisations and ...'.

The dataset's portal record (package_show id=hk-afcd-afcdlist-red-tide-location) carries license_title=None and license_id=None; the dataset page shows no separate licence field, so the portal terms are the governing instrument.

The red tide CSV resource has no per-file terms page; the AFCD data specification PDF states no licence. The HK portal precedent (candidate hk-datagov-portal) recorded the same portal terms as class B with attribution and no share-alike; no candidate-specific risk acceptance is being extended here.
split_strategy: Time-based by report year, computed from the source (rows / distinct sighting numbers / distinct locations): train 1975-2010 = 1,108 / 987 / 329; eval 2011-2018 = 488 / 446 / 236; holdout 2019-2026 = 335 / 324 / 166. Yearly report counts 1975-2026 never fall to zero (recent range 12-114), so every window carries both classes. Positives cluster: 1,615 of 1,757 sighting numbers occupy one row, 111 occupy two, 30 occupy three and 1 occupies four, so the clustered unit is the sighting number, not the row.

measurements.publication_lag_evidence_2026_10_23: Latest record is 8 days before the 2025-04-02 capture but 155 days before the 2019-11-02 capture; the 2022-03-14 press release carried sightings dated 2022-03-12/13. measurements.epd_feature_probe_2026_10_23: 1 anonymous GET of marine-historical-2024-en.csv -> HTTP 200, 618,074 bytes, 2,923 lines, 28 documented columns; not yet measured for the full 1986-2025 series.
measurements.web_probe_notes_2026_10_23: data.gov.hk package_list enumerates 3,831 package names and package_show returns full resource lists anonymously. The red tide network page (redtide.afcd.gov.hk) is a JS app returning a 0-byte body to a plain client. The Wayback capture count is 4, so a lag distribution cannot be built from archive vintages alone.

rejection_reason: Parked on the timing contract, not on licence, target or novelty. The source is anonymous and licences clean (class B), the event archive is long and effectively append-only (1,931 rows, 1,757 sightings, 1975-2026), and the novelty check recorded 'differentiated'. But the label timestamp is undocumented: AFCD's own data specification describes 'Date of Report' only as 'Date.', and the observed publication lag ranges from 8 days (2025 vintage) to 155 days (2019 vintage) with just 4 Wayback captures in total. A weekly prediction instant and a future-only target window therefore cannot be stated with evidence, and the negative population is censored because no per-day monitoring log is published (only a sampling schedule). Building an as-of panel now would assume a lag bound the evidence does not support.
next_action: Do not construct until the timing contract is resolved. Reopen only when one of these is obtained: (a) an AFCD statement or updated data dictionary defining 'Date of Report' and the weekly update day/time (the current PDF defines the field only as 'Date.'); (b) a publication-lag distribution from >=12 consecutive captures of the CSV - NOT obtainable from Wayback (only 4 captures, 2018/2019/2025), so it requires seeding a weekly standing collector into private staging now and revisiting after 6-12 months (the tw-reservoir standing-collector pattern); (c) an operator decision to accept a clearly labelled RETROSPECTIVE benchmark (no historical operational-availability claim), using the 1975-2026 event list with same-era features and time-based splits - the split counts in this record already show that design is feasible. Secondary design issue for whoever reopens: the negative class needs an eligible population; either restrict to the 6 weekly-sampled core fish culture zones and state the censoring, or obtain the per-site monitoring schedule.

prior_art: NOAA HAB forecast bulletins (Gulf of Maine, Florida)
novelty_check.theirs: AFCD publishes the raw sighting list; NOAA and Florida FWC publish Karenia brevis cell-count monitoring and operational HAB bulletins; published HAB ML studies use cell concentrations, not a packaged occurrence-onset benchmark with splits
novelty_check.ours: Hong Kong event-level red tide sighting archive 1975-2026 (1,757 sightings, species+coordinates) formulated as an as-of, next-7-day occurrence onset task at fish-culture-zone/marine-station grain, with documented reporting coverage, temporal splits and persistence/climatology baselines
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
